name: Glass Aurora
tagline: One aurora in the sky, frosted glass where things float.
description: A dark-first system built around a single aurora field per screen. Floating layers (navbar, modal, toast, the hero card) are frosted glass over that field; everything in the page flow stays on a solid surface. Wide Unbounded headlines, Manrope for reading, pill controls, and one aurora green that marks the action or the good news.

fonts.role: display headlines, wordmark, and big numerals
body, labels, buttons, and tables with tabular numerals

palette.role: page background and the base of the aurora field
solid surface for in-flow content: tables, forms, tiles
glass-pane fill, 72 percent opaque so text stays AA over the aurora
1px top highlight and hairline on glass panes; decorative, never a control edge
aurora green: the primary action, good news, live; one per screen
aurora field only: cyan band; never a UI accent
aurora field only: rose top band; never a UI accent

allowedGradients.reason: the one aurora field per screen, behind floating glass layers; it depicts the product's subject and gives the glass something to read against

allowedOrnaments.reason: frosted surface for floating layers only (navbar, modal, popover, toast, hero card) so they stay legible over the aurora field; falls back to the solid surface without backdrop-filter support or with reduced transparency
light blur behind an open modal so the page underneath reads as inactive

do: Use one aurora-sky field per screen, placed where floating layers sit, and keep body copy off it
Put glass-pane only on layers that float above the page: navbar, modal, popover, toast, the one hero card
Keep everything in the page flow on the solid surface token: tables, forms, lists, bento tiles
Make the key number giant in Unbounded with tabular numerals
Use pill shapes for buttons, badges, and toggles, and the radius tokens for panes
dont: Do not stack glass on glass
Do not use aurora-b or aurora-c as UI colors; they exist only inside the aurora field
Do not place text directly on the aurora field without a glass pane
Do not add glows, gradient text, or a second aurora field
Do not put more than one accent-filled button on a screen; on pages with a hero action, the navbar action is the outline variant

components.name: Button
components.notes: Pill shapes. Primary is an aurora green fill; secondary is an outline pill with an edge border that fills with the surface on hover; ghost is a text link with an arrow. 48px tall, 44px at the small size.

components.name: Input
components.notes: Solid surface field, 12px radius, edge border, Manrope label above, hint below. Focus shows a 2px accent ring; error swaps the border and hint to danger.

components.name: Select
components.notes: Same frame as the input with a chevron; tour options with durations.

components.name: Checkbox and toggle
components.notes: Rounded 6px checkbox that fills accent with a check. Switch is a pill track with a round knob that slides and turns the track accent.

components.name: Badge
components.notes: Pill badges: Kp level with an accent dot, clear and cloudy sky in outline, sold out in danger outline, live with a pulsing dot that stops under reduced motion.

components.name: Card
components.notes: The hero forecast card: glass-pane over an aurora-sky field, giant Kp number, probability, best viewing window, and an hourly sparkline in inline SVG.

components.name: Navbar
components.notes: Floating glass pill over the aurora field: wordmark, links, a primary book action. Mobile collapses into a details menu that opens a glass panel.

components.name: Modal and sheet
components.notes: Glass-pane dialog on a glass-scrim; title, a short booking form on solid fields, actions right-aligned. Full-width sheet on phones.

components.name: Table
components.notes: Tonight's departures on the solid surface: time, tour, seats left, cloud cover, price in NOK, status badge. Tabular numerals, rows stack into cards below 640px.

components.name: Bento grid
components.notes: Solid tiles: Kp 2x2 with an hourly bar chart, cloud cover, moon phase, solar wind speed, and dark hours.

components.name: Empty state
components.notes: Inside a solid frame: a small line drawing of a quiet sky, "No tours tonight", the reason, and one action to set an alert.

components.name: Toast
components.notes: Glass pill, bottom-centered on phones and bottom-left on wide screens, with an undo action.
